summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd., a Dubai-domiciled Ukrainian telecom issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release, Q3 2026 earnings release and investor presentation for the period ended September 30, 2026, filed November 6, 2026. The filing discloses no transaction: revenue rose 17.5% YoY to USD 349 million, EBITDA 10.3% to USD 189 million, net profit USD 99 million and diluted EPS USD 0.36, with 9M26 free cash flow USD 274 million. Management raised 2026 guidance to 15-17% USD revenue growth. This is routine quarterly reporting, not a special situation; watch operating momentum, digital mix and currency translation, not arbitrage.
